text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, I spotted Air Groove 
and Fine Motion……

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly... Even if they send it without 
asking, you should think a little more 
about where to put it—"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer...! I'm sorry for causing such 
a fuss.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Actually, a bunch of packages arrived from 
shops connected to my hometown...

There are many Irish companies and grocery 
stores in Japan that support her. We even 
received a massive shipment of black tea 
leaves once before, but...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Soda bread, fig rolls, flapjack, lamb... 
and plenty more!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, every single one looks soooo 
delicious~!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I know you're happy, but thanks 
to that, there's no room to even step foot 
in this room.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What do you plan to do? Even if you eat 
it, that's quite a lot. It might affect 
your race.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Mrmph... But they went out of their way to 
give this to me...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure they want me to enjoy every 
bite. A gift from my beloved Ireland... I 
want to properly savor all of it."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, I'm a horse girl after all! If 
I put my mind to it, I can finish eating 
all of this today♪"
choice_data_list:
If it interferes with your racing, the 
sender would be sad too.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
! You're right... The best way to repay 
everyone's support is to win the race.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll just have a little taste, and we 
can donate the rest to the cafeteria♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If everyone gets to know the delicious 
foods of Ireland, that would make me so 
very happy!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Now that I've got your seal of 
approval, all that's left is to do my 
bestâª

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, today I'm gonna eat tons and tons 
of nostalgic Irish food~! Ohh~!

And so, Fine Motion cleaned out several 
cardboard boxes of food in no time!
